name: Japanese Escape Games The House
description:
The 17th "Japanese Escape Games" series!

■THE GAME SYSTEM
This game is an escape-the-room game (mystery-adventure game).

■STORY
During a driving-trip in west
We got lost in middle of nowhere

Coincidentally I found a house
And the resident gave me a warm welcome

Fatigue led me to fall asleep
In front of a fireplace――

I woke up to see the room was a total mess
As if it was a whole different room

Something is wrong with this place……
I gotta get out of here ASAP……
